attributes.description: Current settings for each Backblaze B2 bucket.

query.esql: FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS Buckets = COUNT_DISTINCT(entity.id)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS Buckets = COUNT_DISTINCT(entity.id)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS `Public buckets` = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.is_public == true, entity.id, null))

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS `Public buckets` = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.is_public == true, entity.id, null))

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS `Without default encryption` = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.default_server_side_encryption.is_enabled == false, entity.id, null))

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS `Without default encryption` = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.default_server_side_encryption.is_enabled == false, entity.id, null))

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS `Without Object Lock` = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.is_file_lock_enabled == false, entity.id, null))

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS `Without Object Lock` = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.is_file_lock_enabled == false, entity.id, null))

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | EVAL Encryption = CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.default_server_side_encryption.is_client_authorized_to_read == false, "not readable", backblaze_b2.bucket.default_server_side_encryption.is_enabled == true, COALESCE(backblaze_b2.bucket.default_server_side_encryption.mode, "enabled"), "none"), `Object Lock` = CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.is_client_authorized_to_read == false, "not readable", backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.is_file_lock_enabled == true, "enabled", "disabled"), `Default retention` = CONCAT(backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.default_retention.mode, " ", TO_STRING(backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.default_retention.period.duration), " ", backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.default_retention.period.unit), Replication = CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_client_authorized_to_read == false, "not readable", backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_replication_source == true AND backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_replication_destination == true, "source and destination", backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_replication_source == true, "source", backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_replication_destination == true, "destination", "none"), `Last seen` = @timestamp | KEEP entity.name, backblaze_b2.bucket.bucket_type, backblaze_b2.bucket.is_public, Encryption, `Object Lock`, `Default retention`, Replication, backblaze_b2.bucket.lifecycle_rules_count, backblaze_b2.bucket.revision, `Last seen` | RENAME entity.name AS Bucket, backblaze_b2.bucket.bucket_type AS Type, backblaze_b2.bucket.is_public AS Public, backblaze_b2.bucket.lifecycle_rules_count AS `Lifecycle rules`, backblaze_b2.bucket.revision AS Revision | SORT Bucket

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | EVAL Encryption = CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.default_server_side_encryption.is_client_authorized_to_read == false, "not readable", backblaze_b2.bucket.default_server_side_encryption.is_enabled == true, COALESCE(backblaze_b2.bucket.default_server_side_encryption.mode, "enabled"), "none"), `Object Lock` = CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.is_client_authorized_to_read == false, "not readable", backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.is_file_lock_enabled == true, "enabled", "disabled"), `Default retention` = CONCAT(backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.default_retention.mode, " ", TO_STRING(backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.default_retention.period.duration), " ", backblaze_b2.bucket.file_lock_configuration.default_retention.period.unit), Replication = CASE(backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_client_authorized_to_read == false, "not readable", backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_replication_source == true AND backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_replication_destination == true, "source and destination", backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_replication_source == true, "source", backblaze_b2.bucket.replication_configuration.is_replication_destination == true, "destination", "none"), `Last seen` = @timestamp | KEEP entity.name, backblaze_b2.bucket.bucket_type, backblaze_b2.bucket.is_public, Encryption, `Object Lock`, `Default retention`, Replication, backblaze_b2.bucket.lifecycle_rules_count, backblaze_b2.bucket.revision, `Last seen` | RENAME entity.name AS Bucket, backblaze_b2.bucket.bucket_type AS Type, backblaze_b2.bucket.is_public AS Public, backblaze_b2.bucket.lifecycle_rules_count AS `Lifecycle rules`, backblaze_b2.bucket.revision AS Revision | SORT Bucket

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS Buckets = COUNT_DISTINCT(entity.id) BY Type = backblaze_b2.bucket.bucket_type | SORT Buckets DESC

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | INLINE STATS latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY entity.id | WHERE @timestamp == latest | STATS Buckets = COUNT_DISTINCT(entity.id) BY Type = backblaze_b2.bucket.bucket_type | SORT Buckets DESC

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | STATS Changes = COUNT_DISTINCT(backblaze_b2.bucket.revision) - 1, `First revision` = MIN(backblaze_b2.bucket.revision), `Latest revision` = MAX(backblaze_b2.bucket.revision), `Last seen` = MAX(@timestamp) BY Bucket = entity.name | WHERE Changes > 0 | SORT Changes DESC

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.bucket-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.bucket" AND event.kind == "asset" | STATS Changes = COUNT_DISTINCT(backblaze_b2.bucket.revision) - 1, `First revision` = MIN(backblaze_b2.bucket.revision), `Latest revision` = MAX(backblaze_b2.bucket.revision), `Last seen` = MAX(@timestamp) BY Bucket = entity.name | WHERE Changes > 0 | SORT Changes DESC
